title: vote.trivia.open
description: server → host and clients. The vote is tied and FLIGHT's ballot did not decide it: a single fact question is asked. Sent together with vote.stage TIEBREAK_TRIVIA. The first correct answer, in order of arrival at the server, wins the right to pick among the tied options.

question.description: The question without its answer; `id` is the fact id.

tiedOptionIds.description: The tied options, in display order.

DataId.description: Identifier of an entry in the shared game data (`data/`): part, part category, contract, test, anomaly card, minigame, fact, codex entry, callout, console request, award, objective, validation rule, cosmetic. 1–48 characters.

OptionId.description: Identifier of one option inside a vote round. For PART votes it equals the part id; for CONTRACT votes the contract id; for PILOT votes a PlayerId; for quick votes an upper-case token defined in the vote-kind table (e.g. TEST, SKIP).

QuestionPublic.description: A multiple-choice question without its answer (server → clients).

id.description: Question or fact id in the game data.

RoundId.description: Vote round identifier chosen by the host; unique within the room for its whole lifetime.

TextRef.description: Reference to localised player-visible text. The protocol never carries free display text: `key` is a key of `data/strings/<lang>.json`, and `args` supplies substitution values. Receivers format numbers and units locally.

args.description: Substitution values by placeholder name. String values must themselves be data ids or string-table keys, never user text.
